resource_name.title: Resource name
resource_name.description: Path of the file relative to the root of the submitted directory (not just its basename), matching the path the file has inside the zip archive.

description.title: Description
description.description: Optional description of the resource (e.g. how it relates to the dataset)

resource_type.title: Resource type
resource_type.description: What kind of resource is it (original image, cells measurements, ...)

linked_level.title: Linked level
linked_level.$comment: TODO: add check of possible values?

linked_label.title: Linked label
linked_label.$comment: TODO: add validty check of values?

fname_resource.title: File path / name of the resource

status.title: Status
status.description: Automated readiness check result: "ok" (ready for submission as-is), "review" (needs manual attention before this dataset can be zipped, see `note`), or "ignore" (excluded from the archive, e.g. a junk file or one already required as a core submission file).

note.title: Note
note.description: Explanation for `status`, e.g. why a file needs review or is ignored.
